description: August 26 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 1, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 26 birthday falls in Virgo, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of an August 26 birthday
paragraphs: Precision meets ambition on the 26th of August. Three degrees into Virgo, in Mercury's own decan, the Sun pairs with 8, the number of management and material results. Interpretive traditions describe an efficient operator who builds success through attention to detail. Recognition may come slowly, but this birthday tends to earn it thoroughly.

By noon UTC on August 26, the Sun has normally reached roughly 3° of Virgo. That places the date in the Virgo decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the first of three. Mercury rules Virgo and also governs its opening decan, from about August 23 to September 2. Doubled Mercury in an earth sign points towards analysis, method and a talent for noticing the detail everyone else walked past. People with these birthdays are often called helpful, articulate and quietly witty, with high standards for their own work. The flip side is a busy mind that can turn on itself, cataloguing flaws long after the job is done. Their best gift tends to be useful precision: making a system clearer, a text tighter or a routine kinder to the people who follow it.

sections.heading: Numerology of the August 26 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 26th reduces as 2 + 6 = 8. Here the 2's cooperative instinct and the 6's sense of responsibility build towards the 8's practical power. Twenty-sixth-born people are often described as capable organisers who lead through care, managing a household, a business or a community with both warmth and firmness. They tend to think about security for the people they love. As a secondary number, the 26 is traditionally associated with sound judgement in material matters. Balancing control with trust in others is often part of their path.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same August 26 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: August 26 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 26 is the 238th day of the year (239th in a leap year). In most years Libra season is under way by September 23, 28 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 26 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. August 26 is also the birthday of Mother Teresa (1910), Antoine Lavoisier (1743) and Chris Pine (1980).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 26?
faq.answer: August 26 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 26?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 26 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 26th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 26?
faq.answer: By August 26 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 26?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an August 26 birthday are Mother Teresa (1910), Antoine Lavoisier (1743) and Chris Pine (1980). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
